project_type: Python CLI (sars-convert / 'mussannoni') that converts Mwanza SARS Form-Two mock result reports from pdf2html dumps into clean HTML+CSS and prints them to PDF via WeasyPrint. Two paths: a 'conversion' path (redraws one specific reference PDF) and a data-driven 'template' path (rebuilds from extracted data).
build_system: uv (uv.lock present). Run everything through `uv run`. No compiled build step.
build_command: uv run python -c "import sars" (import smoke) and `uv run sars list`
verification_instructions: Per report: (1) regenerate data+templates with `uv run sars data` then `uv run sars template --only "<name>"` (NOTE: --only is SUBSTRING match, so "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" also matches "...SUBJECTWISE"; pass the full unique name). (2) Logical fidelity: `uv run python tools/cell_diff.py "<name>" --template -v` (exact-name-first, aim 0 mismatches). (3) Pixel fidelity: `uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "<name>" --template` (LOSSLESS, dimension-locked; prints exact% and visible% match, MAE/RMSE/PSNR; REQUIRES the generated page dimensions to equal the reference, which only happens once the template emits the reference's own Letter page box). A DIMENSION MISMATCH from pixel_diff means the page size or count is still wrong. (4) End of task: `uv run pytest -q` must stay green and the conversion path must stay 19/19.
snapshot_or_generated_files: output/ is intentionally committed. Generated artefacts: output/data/*.json (`uv run sars data`), output/template_html/*.html + output/template_pdf/*.pdf (`uv run sars template`), output/html/*.html + output/pdf/*.pdf (`uv run sars all`), output/compare/* (tools/compare.py [--template], tools/pixel_diff.py). Reference PDFs under data/sars/**/*.pdf are READ-ONLY ground truth and must NEVER be overwritten.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already resolved via uv. `uv run <cmd>` works out of the box. Real Microsoft corefonts (Arial, Arial-Bold, Times New Roman + bold) are installed system-wide under /usr/share/fonts/msttcore; `fc-match "Arial"` and `fc-match "Times New Roman"` resolve to the real fonts. Liberation Sans/Serif and Nimbus Sans Narrow are also present.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN_INTERNET. No Docker involved. WeasyPrint + Pango/Cairo/HarfBuzz present. pdfplumber + PyMuPDF (pymupdf) available. Fonts are real; do not re-fetch.
contribution_requirements: Work only on the current branch regenerate-fresh-output. Do NOT push, open PRs, or modify git config. Do NOT overwrite reference PDFs in data/sars/. Leave the working tree ready for the orchestrator to review and regenerate. The orchestrator will do a final full fresh regeneration.
key_patterns: PROJECT LEARNING (authoritative): each report type is its OWN self-contained artefact; do NOT force a shared stylesheet or merge structures across report types; fidelity to each original per-report is the only success criterion; efficiency-over-abstraction is acceptable (per-report independence preferred over premature sharing). The reference implementation to imitate is src/sars/templates/schools_rank.py: FIXED-LAYOUT, self-contained. It hard-codes recovered column widths and table origins in points, sets @page to the reference's own Letter page size (792pt 612pt), positions tables with position:absolute at recovered coordinates, uses per-row heights, per-cell fill-wash classes keyed to recovered fills, real Arial/Times New Roman, rotated rank captions, and font sizes/weights matching the recovered Style. The FIDELITY ORACLE is src/sars/model.py via sars.extract.extract_document(pdf, html): it returns Document.pages (each Page.width/height in pt, Page.blocks of tables/text), Table.col_edges/row_edges, Cell.row/col/rowspan/colspan and Cell.style (family,size_pt,bold,italic,color,background,align,rotation). READ exact coordinates/fonts/fills/spans/row pitches/page size/page count from the reference PDF via this API rather than guessing. Note extract_document takes pathlib.Path arguments (pair.pdf / pair.html), NOT strings. The competency band colour is the ONLY data-derived colour, computed deterministically via sars.competency; never stored.
relevant_files: src/sars/templates/schools_rank.py (REFERENCE PATTERN: fixed-layout council schools-rank, 0 cell mismatches, correct Letter page)
src/sars/templates/__init__.py (RENDERERS + TEMPLATE_NAMES registry mapping report_type -> renderer)
src/sars/templates/styling.py (Sheet accumulator, document(), fit_scale() A4 helper - the A4 path that CAUSES the wrong page size for the non-fixed renderers)
src/sars/templates/school_result_slip.py (school_result_slip; 13p currently A4, has #92cddc panel wash)
src/sars/extract_data.py (extract_report: Document -> schema instance handed to templates)
tools/pixel_diff.py (LOSSLESS dimension-locked pixel comparator; writes PIXEL DIFF/PIXEL OVERLAY PNGs)
tools/compare.py (lossy side-by-side JPEG; SUBSTRING match gotcha; writes '<name>' and 'TEMPLATE <name>' JPEGs)
directory_structure: src/sars/ conversion+template package; src/sars/templates/ per-report renderers + base.py/styling.py + __init__.py registry; tools/ diagnostic scripts (compare.py, pixel_diff.py, cell_diff.py, probe.py, template_audit.py, template_missing.py); data/sars/{council_html,council_pdf,region_html,region_pdf}/ + S1051 pair (read-only ground truth); output/{data,html,pdf,template_html,template_pdf,compare}/ committed artefacts; tests/test_sars.py.
